consequences: Stored intent authorizes only its same identity operation. Lost receipts are re-read and retried idempotently with explicit UI confirmation. User exports/backups are outside whole-space deletion. Installed UI, real vault and full fault matrix remain separate gates.
context: File-save and whole-space data rights require trusted Host ownership and truthful completion. Partial credential removal, process loss or lost receipts must not reopen partially erased data.
decision: Export allowlisted owner-scoped summaries and diagnostics through native Save File with confirmed atomic save receipts. Persist catalog erasure intent before drain, invoke scoped offline helper under exclusive identity lock, persist a sibling erasure fence, then reconcile catalog/preferences into a fresh identity before restart. Pending identity is blocked by Host and Gateway startup, with a dedicated recovery UI.
title: Durable current-space erasure intent and recovery
